meta.homeTitle: Screenshot (App) Maker — Litšoantšo tsa App Store, li entsoe habonolo
meta.homeDescription: Etsa litšoantšo tsa App Store tse hlakileng le tse lokiselitseng ho romela, 'me u sebelise Ollama ho etsa mefuta e fetoleloang ka puo ea sebaka habonolo.
meta.ollamaDescription: Kopanya Screenshot (App) Maker le seva ya hau ea Ollama bakeng sa phetolelo ea litšoantšo e thusitsoang ke AI e private.
meta.privacyDescription: Fututsisa hore na Screenshot (App) Maker e boloka litšoantšo tsa hau, likhoahlo, le tsela ea mosebetsi ea phetolelo ho ba private.

features.titleHtml:
Sebelisa nako e nyane ho itokisetsa.
Phatlalatsa ka ts'episo e kholo.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker e fetola mosebetsi o pheta-phetoang qetellong ea ho phatlalatsa app ho ba ts'ebetso e hlakileng le e bonahalang.

cards.title: Tjhefatsa lifoto tsa skrine ea hau.
cards.body: Kenya lifoto tsa skrine, li be ka har'a likhoutu tse hlophisitsoeng tsa lisebelisoa, 'me u hlophise pale e felletseng ea App Store ka metsotsoana.

cards.title: Rala hang.
cards.body: Sebelisa mebala, likhoutu, litlhophiso tsa lisebelisoa, lithoto, le litšila ho leqephe le leng le le leng ha u boloka molaetsa o mong le o mong o ikhethang.

cards.title: Ama skrine e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
cards.body: Itokisetse lintho tse hlokahalang bakeng sa iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, le litšoantšo tsa feature ho tsoa morerong o le mong.

cards.title: Romella pakete e itokisetsileng ho kenngoa.
cards.body: Hlahisa litšoantšo tse nang le boleng bo phahameng, hlophisa lifaele tse fetolelitsoeng, 'me u kopanye metadata ea hau ea App Store e fetotsoeng ho ba archive e hloekileng.

localization.pill: E tsamaisoa ke seva sa hau sa Ollama
localization.title: Kampene ea hau ea litšoantšo tsa skrine, e loketse ho bua le 'maraka o mong le o mong.
localization.description: Hokela Screenshot (App) Maker ho Ollama 'me u fetolele li-headline tsa litšoantšo tsa skrine le tlhahisoleseling ea App Store ka ts'ebetso e le 'ngoe. Sebopeho sa hau sa mantlha se sala se sa fetohe ha mangolo a fetoha bakeng sa sebaka se seng le se seng.
checks: Fetolela headline e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea litšoantšo tsa skrine ka sehlopha.
Lokisa tlhaloso, mantsoe a bohlokoa, le mananeo a ntjhafatso.
Hlahloba li-fetolelo pele ho romelloa ho qetela.
localization.action: Sheba tataiso ea ho beha Ollama.
localization.completeBody: Mongolo le metadata li loketse ho hlahlojoa.

workflow.overline: Tsela e khuts'oane bakeng sa ho phatlalatsa.
workflow.title: Kenya lifilimi tsa mantlha. Ntša lisebelisoa tse loketseng polokelo.
workflow.description: Ha ho tlhophiso e rarahaneng ea moralo. Ha ho hlokahale ho aha bocha lekhampa le tšoanang bakeng sa puo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.

steps.title: Kenya
steps.body: Eketsa marotholi a skrine a bontšang pale ea sesebelisoa sa hau ka ho fetisisa.

steps.title: Moralo le ho fetolela setso
steps.body: Hahela ponahalo e le 'ngoe, ebe o fetolela mangolo a hau ka Ollama.

steps.title: Romela kantle
steps.body: Jara litšoantšo le metadata tse hlophisitsoeng, u loketse ho romela.

privacy.title: Lithoto tsa sesebelisoa sa hau li lula li laoloa ke uena.
privacy.description: Ho lokisa litšoantšo tsa skrine ho etsahala sesebelisoeng sa hau. Ha o khetha Ollama, mantsoe a romeloa feela ho aterese ea seva eo u e hlophisitseng.

final.overline: Ho tloha litšoantšong ho isa ho romelloa
final.title: Etsa hore mohato oa ho qetela o be bonolo.
final.description: Rala, fetolela le ntša screenshot e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe eo phatlalatso ea hau e latelang ea app e hlokang.

ollama.title: Thuto ea ho Hlophisa Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Hokela Screenshot (App) Maker ho instance ea hau ea Ollama bakeng sa phetolelo ea AI le tlhahiso ea mantsuoa.
requirements: Khomphutha ea Mac, Windows PC kapa Linux ho tsamaisa Ollama
iPhone/iPad ea hau ho marang-rang a tšoanang le khomphutha ea Ollama (e khothaletsoa)
steps: Kenya Ollama: jarolla le ho kenya Ollama bakeng sa tsamaiso ea hau.
Qala Ollama: tsamaisa ollama serve (kapa bula sesebelisoa sa Ollama ho macOS).
Hula mofuta: tsamaisa ollama pull llama3.2 (kapa mofuta oo u o khethileng).
Tlhomma hore e sebetsa: tsamaisa ollama run llama3.2 le ho lekola taelo.
Fumana aterese ea seva sa hau: ngola IP ea LAN ea khomphutha ea hau (mohlala, 192.168.0.10).
E sebelisa ho sesebelisoa: litlhophisong tsa Screenshot (App) Maker, behela Host ho http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Haeba sesebelisoa se ke ke sa hokahana, netefatsa hore mohala le khomphutha ea hau li holim'a marang-rang a Wi‑Fi a tšoanang.
Netefatsa hore port 11434 e lumelletsoe ke firewall ea hau.
Haeba u khetha ho sebelisa seva se hole (PC ea lehae, VPS), u tlameha ho bula port ka tsela e sireletsehileng (VPN e khothaletsoa).
ollama.ctaBody: Boela ho sesebelisoa, lekola kamano, 'me u qale ka puo e le' ngoe.
ollama.metaTitle: Thuto ea ho Beha Ollama — Screenshot (App) Maker

privacy.title: Leano la Lekunutu
privacy.intro: Leano lena la Lekunutu le hlalosa hore na Screenshot (App) Maker ("App") e sebetsana joang ka data ea mosebelisi.
summary: Ha ho na li-account. Ha ho na tlhatlhobo. Ha ho na latelo.
Lifaele le liphetoho tsa hau li sala sesebelisong sa hau haeba u sa khetha ho hokela ho seva ea hau ea Ollama.
Haeba u sebelisa Ollama, molaetsa o romelloa feela ho aterese ea seva eo u e hlophisang.

sections.title: Kopano ea Tlhahisoleseling
body: App ha e bokelle, boloke, kapa e romelle tlhahisoleseling ea motho ka mong ho li-seva tsa rona.
Litšoantšo tsa skrineng, mehlala le litšoantšo tse hlahisoang li a etsoa 'me li bolokoa sebakeng sa sejoale-joale ho sesebeliswa sa hau.

sections.title: Phihlello ho Lifaele le Litšoantšo
body: App e ka kopa phihlello ho App ea Lifaele kapa polokelo ea litšoantšo tsa hau ho kenya litšoantšo tsa skrineng.
Litšoantšo tse kentsoeng li sebetswa ka har'a sesebeliswa 'me ha li romelloe ka boiketsetso.

sections.title: Phetolelo ea AI (Ollama)
body: Haeba u lumella ho hlahisoa kapa phetolelo ea mantswe a AI, App e ka romella mantswe ho seva sa Ollama seo u se behang (mohlala, khomphutha ea hau).
Ha re tsamaisa kapa ha re amohelle phallo ea hau ea Ollama, 'me App ha e ngole kapa e boloke litlhaku tse sebetsitsoeng ke AI.

sections.title: Litšebeletso tsa Ba bang
body: App ha e sebelise litlhahlobo tsa ba bang, li-SDK tsa patlo kapa mekhoa ea ho latela.

sections.title: Liphetoho
body: Re ka nchafatsa Leano lena la Tšireletso ea Boitsebiso nakong e fapaneng. Liphetoho li tla bonahala leqepheng lena.

sections.title: Ikopanye
body: Haeba u na le lipotso mabapi le Molao-motheo ona oa Poloko ea Tlhahisoleseling, ka kopo ikopanye le rona ka aterese ea lengolo-tsoibila e fanoeng tsebiso ea App Store.
